description: This file implements session management for PHP4 using the ADODB database abstraction layer. It provides functions for opening, reading, writing, destroying, and garbage collecting sessions stored in a database table, supporting features like notifications on session expiry and handling BLOBs/CLOBs. The script includes setup instructions, configuration parameters, and sample usage demonstrating its role as a session handler component.

methods.name: adodb_sess_open
methods.description: Establishes a connection to the database for session storage, reusing existing connection if available.

methods.name: adodb_sess_close
methods.description: Closes the database connection used for session storage.

methods.name: adodb_sess_read
methods.description: Reads session data from the database using the session key.

methods.name: adodb_sess_write
methods.description: Writes session data to the database, updating or inserting as needed, with support for LOBs.

methods.name: adodb_sess_destroy
methods.description: Deletes a session record from the database and triggers expiry notifications if configured.

methods.name: adodb_sess_gc
methods.description: Performs garbage collection by removing expired session records and optionally optimizing the table.
